Modular suite of advanced automations for business operations:

→ Employee Onboarding — auto-creates accounts, assigns tasks, notifies IT
→ Financial Reconciliation Bot — AI-powered ERP cross-check, flags discrepancies
→ Customer Support Escalation — sentiment analysis, auto-assigns via Slack/WhatsApp
→ Executive Summary Generator — daily KPI reports via OpenAI → Notion/Drive

Security: PostgreSQL/Supabase audit logs, retry logic, GDPR/LGPD compliant

Comprehensive automation for ecommerce:

→ RAG 24/7 AI Support integrated with product catalog
→ Cart Recovery — abandoned cart detection + personalized email sequences
→ AI Upsell & Follow-up — tailored product recommendations
→ Weekly Insights — automated buyer analytics and sales reports

AI-powered WhatsApp assistant for barbershops:

→ Automates customer service, FAQs, and appointment booking
→ Sends reminders, operates 24/7 without manual input
→ Integrated with Google Calendar and scheduling spreadsheets

AI-driven WhatsApp ordering system:

→ Customers order via WhatsApp with instant confirmation
→ Real-time tracking via Google Sheets or POS integration
→ Reduces errors, minimizes phone traffic, improves UX

AI assistant for real estate agencies:

→ Qualifies leads via WhatsApp or web chat
→ Auto-updates CRM with buyer/renter preferences
→ Schedules viewings and follow-ups automatically
